summary: Frontend-only verification of the DynoPay in-app UX overhaul (Transactions, Customers, Your page editor + Products, Developers table, Refer & earn, Invoices/Wallet/Dashboard total labels, per-account server-side Page Tips, Notifications, Payouts, dark mode, scroll shadow). All 10 feature areas pass. Zero horizontal overflow at 1440/1280/390 on every page. All documented data-testids present and functional. Page-tip server-side persistence verified end-to-end (dismiss as QA 221 -> reload -> clear localStorage -> switch to merchant: all states behave as specified). No regressions blocking the user flow. Only 1 LOW observation listed below.

issues: Mobile toolbar visually puts the search input, sort select, 'Add customer' and export icon on a single wrapping flex row that happens to look like one row at 390px (desktop screenshot shows a dedicated full-width search row above sort+Add+export). Spec says 'search on its own row, then sort select + Add customer + export icon on ONE row'. Current layout technically meets this on load; just flagging because at narrower-than-390 the search input could squish. No functional impact.

functional_results.login_injection: PASS - merchant token + last_company_id='1' + mfa_interstitial_seen injected via /auth/login origin, both merchant (user 1 / company 1 'The Dev Store') and QA (user 221 / company 231) sessions load.
functional_results.transactions_toolbar_1440: PASS - search input (icon inside, debounced live), period presets, Filters button opens right side panel [tx-filter-sheet] anchored at x=1020 w=420 (right side on 1440). Export button opens menu with export-all + export-settled-only. No VAT/TAX column (0 tax rows). Overflow 0 @ 1440/1280/390. 390 crypto amount: no ellipsis truncation.
functional_results.customers_page: PASS - 'Paying' is default active segment (dark pill, filled chip). KPI 'Paying customers' = 0 with sub '+ 12 invited, not paid yet'. Net Revenue KPI has InfoHint [customers-stat-revenue-hint]. Empty state [customers-empty-unidentified] title 'No paying customers with contact details yet' with 'View unidentified payments' button that successfully switches to [customers-segment-anonymous] on click (confirmed by DOM state change). Invited/All segments present. GET /api/userApi/customers/directory?company_id=1&segment=paying returns 200. No overflow @ 1440/1280/390.
functional_results.your_page_storefront: PASS - H1='Your page'. 'Editing The Dev Store' chip present. [your-page-edit-btn] + [your-page-funnel-checkouts-hint] FOUND. All 6 EditorSections (profile/look/socials/tips/store/analytics) + toggles + summaries FOUND. Sticky save bar [creator-save-bar] stays visible when scrolling (bbox y=792 after scroll in 900h viewport). [creator-save-btn] starts disabled; typing in bio flipped [creator-save-bar-status] from 'When on, anyone with your link can view your page and support you.' to 'You have unsaved changes' and button became enabled. DID NOT click Save. [creator-edit-handle-btn] + [creator-enabled-switch] present. No overflow at any breakpoint.
functional_results.your_page_products: PASS - [products-toolbar] single row with [products-search-input], [products-status-filter] (no floating label), [products-view-toggle], [products-view-shop-btn], [products-new-btn]. Each product row has [product-row-edit-<id>] + [product-row-menu-<id>] with all 4 labeled items: 'Create a payment link' / 'View sales' / 'Open public page' / 'Archive'. DID NOT confirm archive. 'Compare brand pages' card title confirmed.
functional_results.developers_table: PASS - [api-keys-table] with 2 [api-key-row-<id>] rows (233 live, 92 test). Every per-row child testid present (env/status/display/currency-select/last-used/expires/menu). ⋯ menu items api-regenerate-btn + api-toggle-status-btn + api-delete-btn all FOUND. Opened delete modal -> [delete-modal-confirm] + [delete-modal-cancel] present -> cancelled (did NOT delete). [sandbox-badge] + [sandbox-limits] FOUND on test key. Footnotes [api-key-shown-once-notice] + [api-base-currency-helper] both present. Overflow 0 at 1440/1280/390.
functional_results.refer_and_earn: PASS - H1 'Refer & earn'. Hero [referral-code-card] with [referral-link-value], [copy-referral-link-btn] (toast 'Referral link copied to clipboard!'), [share-referral-btn], [referral-code-value] + [copy-referral-code-btn], [share-whatsapp-btn] / [share-telegram-btn] / [share-x-btn]. [referrals-zero-state] + [referral-how-it-works] rendered. [referral-earnings-card] correctly ABSENT (user 1 has 0 referrals). No '$0.00' values, no 'Leaderboard'.
functional_results.totals_labels: PASS - /invoices: 'Gross collected $35,052.58' with [invoices-tile-collected-hint]; Tax row shows $0.00 but no VAT column in table. /wallet: eyebrow 'Net received · all time' with [wallet-total-hint]. /dashboard: aria-label/title text 'Your fee tier follows lifetime net volume: completed payments after Dynopay fees, all time — the same figure as Net received on Payout addresses.' confirmed in DOM.
functional_results.page_tips_per_account: PASS (full end-to-end) - As QA user 221: GET /api/track/page-tips -> {ok:true,dismissed:['payouts']} as expected. Visited /transactions, found button [data-testid='page-tip-dismiss-transactions'] with aria-label 'Got it', clicked. GET /api/track/page-tips -> {ok:true,dismissed:['payouts','transactions']}. Reloaded page -> tip stayed hidden. Cleared ALL localStorage except token+last_company_id, reloaded -> tip STILL hidden (confirms server-side per-user cache works). Switched to merchant token in same browser -> merchant SEES 'Got it' tip on /transactions (confirms per-user cache scoping). Did NOT dismiss any tips as user 1.
functional_results.notifications_payouts_wallet: PASS - [notifications-kind-all] active chip bg=rgb(17,18,20) color=rgb(255,255,255) = dark pill (not yellow). [payouts-wallets-toggle-quiet] FOUND on /payouts. /wallet overflow 0 @ 1440/390.
functional_results.cross_cutting: PASS - [main-page-header] data-scrolled toggles 'false' -> 'true' after scrolling (hairline/shadow trigger). Dark mode (theme-mode-inapp='dark') verified readable on Customers (body bg rgb(19,19,18)), Developers table, Refer & earn - no low-contrast surfaces, text + icons remain legible. No console errors from the changed components (only environmental 429/chunk-load errors from Cloudflare edge rate limiting when navigating too fast - resolved by pacing).

critical_code_review_comments: Cloudflare edge aggressively 429s static chunk requests when navigating multiple pages in rapid succession (observed on /payouts, /notifications, /wallet after fast nav). The app's [DynamicFallback] already surfaces 'lazy section failed to load: ChunkLoadError' errors to the console - consider adding a user-facing retry/toast and/or a soft retry in the dynamic loader so a transient 429 doesn't leave a blank panel.

GET /api/userApi/customers/directory?company_id=1&segment=paying returned top-level keys ['message','data'] - the review spec expected 'aggregates' with paying_customers/invited_count/anonymous_buckets. Values are clearly surfacing in the UI (526 payments / $34,075.29 unidentified bucket, '+ 12 invited') so aggregates are being carried under data; just flagging the shape for the review item that said 'aggregates include ...' - verify whether the contract description expected them at root or nested.
test_credentials: Merchant: user 1 / company 1 'The Dev Store' - token at /app/memory/tmp/merchant_token.txt. QA: user 221 / company 231 - token at /app/memory/tmp/qa221_token.txt (used ONLY for page-tip dismissal writes).
seed_data_creation: None. Only persistent side-effect: added 'transactions' to QA user 221's dismissed page-tip list via /api/track/page-tips/dismiss as per the review request's own test instruction. No writes to merchant (user 1) account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 10 UX-overhaul feature groups verified against the preview build at https://ux-handoff-app.preview.emergentagent.com. If re-testing: inject merchant token on /auth/login origin first, then navigate (don't paste token on an app page - localStorage won't be set in time). Pace navigation ~15-20s between heavy pages (/payouts, /notifications, /wallet have many lazy chunks and Cloudflare 429s them under rapid load). Page-tip server now stores ['payouts','transactions'] for QA user 221.
